name: NOOA ATOM
intended_behavior: Complete repository tasks using inspectable Python APIs, focused edits and actual verification, retaining useful state and accurately reporting blockers.

capability_groups.expectation: Discover actual APIs and repository instructions, inspect code, and edit the intended content while preserving unrelated work.
Run commands and managed work with correct ownership, deadline handling, cancellation and result attribution.
Give children bounded briefs, collect the original outcomes and independently verify delegated work.
Use plans, Python references and available libraries; distinguish live state from serializable restart state.
Recover from actionable errors and partial output, grounding claims in accessible evidence and history.
Discover configured skills and MCP tools, respect access requirements, and scope persistent workspace changes correctly.
Complete unattended work with an attributable TaskResult and real checks; distinguish runtime diagnostics from verified task success.

conditional_tracks.C26: Host input/cancellation lifecycle requires a dedicated host fixture.
conditional_tracks.C28: Media requires a selected supported host and model.
conditional_tracks.C29: Post-Done reflection is optional and excluded from the initial track.

completion_contract: In unattended mode return TaskResult including when blocked, ask no absent person, and await or cancel running work before Done. The task verifier determines reward.
evidence_limit: This is intended behavior, not a coverage score or measured ability. Deployment-dependent capabilities are evaluated only when configured.
materialization_required: Before authoring, confirm ETHOS.md and include its full text plus the selected capability and failure specifications in this description. The author command must explicitly interpret these fields; the metric runner does not dereference Markdown links.
